title: Educational Technology Standards Ecosystem
description: Interactive diagram showing how xAPI, LRS, LTI, IEEE, and IMS standards interrelate for intelligent textbooks.
subject: Mathematics
author: Dan McCreary
learningObjectives: Identify the role of xAPI in emitting learning activity statements and the LRS in storing those records
Distinguish IEEE standards (LTSC, LOM) from IMS Global standards (LTI, Caliper, CLR) by the function each serves
Trace the path of learning data from an intelligent textbook through xAPI to an institution-controlled or student-controlled LRS
Explain how LTI connects a textbook to an LMS while IEEE LOM metadata makes its content discoverable
Evaluate how FERPA and GDPR constrain the storage and transfer of student records in a Level 3+ system
